scope: we mapped the p130Cas interactome and its dynamic changes in response to VEGF using high-resolution mass spectrometry

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study uses a factorial design combining a time-course of VEGF stimulation with a genetic comparison between wild-type and a non-phosphorylatable mutant of p130Cas.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment used a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer in automatic data-dependent switching mode (DDA) and MaxQuant for label-free quantification (LFQ).

workflow: The mass spectrometer was operated in positive ion mode with a capillary temperature of 220°C and a potential of 2000 V applied to the capillary. All data were acquired with the mass spectrometer operating in automatic data-dependent switching mode.

The MaxQuant software suite (v 1.5.0.25) containing the in-built Andromeda search engine was used to identify the proteins from a human database (Uniprot HUMAN, release 2012_01) containing 20,242 entries, and determine their relative concentration by label-free quantification.
differential: Log-transformed protein intensities of p130Cas immunoprecipitates... were compared with the corresponding isogenic controls samples

The comparison was performed using BDiffProt algorithm, which identified differentially expressed proteins between the control (isogenic control, transduced with Ad.p130Cas) and noncontrol (p130cas immunoprecipitates, transduced with Ad.p130Cas or Ad.p130Cas15F) samples.
search_parameters: The search included a fixed modification of Carbamidomethyl (C) and variable modifications of Oxidation (M);Acetyl (Protein N-term).
samples were alkylated with 20 μl iodoacetamide (5 mg/ml) for 30 min in the dark.
